{{Quote|This is an albino farlek. Very rare. As long as it's kept fed, it's suprisingly docile.|Eeksa|<ref name="Operation: Elrood (book)">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>}}
'''Eeksa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She operated the pet shop [[Eeksa's Rare Exotics and Pets]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Brindibarr]] and at some point during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she hired a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents to transport an albino [[farlek]] to the residence of the businessman [[Pelleo Thog]], a collector of rare animals.
